scope: Table stream serialization; actual buffered XML/JSON/protected-output write failures; group ID zero; GUI/core JSON field and parent interchange; imported metadata/forms and GUI JSON codec preservation; GUI staged-save rollback, recent-list/temp-file cleanup, Lua consent and invalid pointer-width rejection.
limits: Core path saves report flush/close errors but write directly and may truncate the previous destination. Only GUI saves tested here stage replacement.
The protected-table failure cap permits the JSON staging payload, then rejects the larger encrypted output and header.
Stored form metadata is preserved; this does not implement Delphi form execution or codecs in every table format.
GUI lifecycle timed out twice before chooser instrumentation. The captured stack waits inside QFileDialog before serialization. Four later observations pass; the chooser stall remains unresolved.
The six-area compatibility objective remains active. No claim of compatibility with every Linux process.
ASan leak detection is disabled as in project CI; GUI checks run offscreen on the native build.

The initial failed GUI binaries were not retained separately; their outputs and blocked stack are archived as observations before chooser instrumentation. Final observer sources and binary have verified hashes.
resourcePolicy: Cached dependencies, nice -n 10, one compiler job. Heavy builds and suites run sequentially. RLIMIT_FSIZE and SIGXFSZ changes apply only to owned test processes and are restored. Qt configuration/cache and temporary files use owned test directories. No host settings/packages/kernels changed.
